ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; dominant low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel background estimated at >85% coverage with localized high-intensity (white) clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency distribution of white circular pixel clusters (diameters 5-15 pixels) scattered across both lobes; highest density of white clusters observed near the distal tips and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged boundary; high-amplitude serrations with several deep, non-uniform concave excisions (notches) distributed across both the left and right lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; terminal taper is sharper on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular white high-contrast pixel clusters; hundreds of discrete markings consistent with barnacle attachment sites distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions oriented horizontally across the mid-section of the right lobe; secondary shorter vertical disruptions visible on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and marginal degradation along the trailing edge consistent with mechanical trauma; dense circular scarring coverage exceeding 15% of total surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized concentration of solid white high-intensity pixels at the extreme distal points (fluke tips).
